name: One shell help
description: Help mode entries for Molly's One shell plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Go to anything
entries.text: Every app's screens, plugins, actions and settings in one place. Type to search all of them, or tap a group to slide into it. The star adds a place to Favorites; on a computer the side buttons open it in a pane or a floating window.

entries.title: Go menu
entries.text: Favorites, Recent, then one sub menu per app, built from what each app registers, so a new plugin shows up here by itself. Long lists fold into A–F style sub menus.

entries.title: One shell settings
entries.text: Layout mode (one at a time, tabs, side by side, IDE), named layouts, how long a menu level may get, which apps show in the menus, favorites and recent.
